label: Speed varies as the square root of linear size in swimming, flight and walking
statement_en: Leaving aside differences in mechanical construction, swimming (Froude's law), flight (minimum stable speed) and walking (the leg swinging as a pendulum) all give the same result: an animal's velocity tends to vary as the square root of its linear dimensions.

hypotheses.name: thompson1917-ch02-10#assumed-1
hypotheses.statement: That the compared animals move at equal Froude number, or fly at v_min with the same ρ and C_L,max.

hypotheses.name: thompson1917-ch02-10#assumed-2
hypotheses.statement: The walking route (the leg as a pendulum) is not formalised.

lean.source:
/-- **R4, conclusion 2.** Under R1, R2 and the same `ρ`, `C_L,max` for every member, `v_min` scales as `√L`. -/
theorem vmin_ratio {W S : ℝ → ℝ} {k₁ k₂ ρ Cmax : ℝ} (hW : CubeLaw W k₁) (hS : AreaLaw S k₂) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hCmax : 0 < Cmax) {L₁ L₂ : ℝ} (h₁ : 0 < L₁) (h₂ : 0 < L₂) :
    vmin ρ Cmax (W L₂) (S L₂) / vmin ρ Cmax (W L₁) (S L₁) = Real.sqrt (L₂ / L₁) := by
  unfold vmin
  have hk₁ := hW.1; have hk₂ := hS.1
  have hx₁ : 0 ≤ 2 * W L₁ / (ρ * S L₁ * Cmax) := by
    rw [hW.2 L₁ h₁, hS.2 L₁ h₁]; positivity
  rw [← Real.sqrt_div' _ (by rw [hW.2 L₁ h₁, hS.2 L₁ h₁]; positivity)]
  congr 1
  rw [hW.2 L₁ h₁, hW.2 L₂ h₂, hS.2 L₁ h₁, hS.2 L₂ h₂]
  field_simp

named_hypotheses.name: Delphi.AreaLaw
named_hypotheses.source:
/-- Isometry of an area: `S L = k L²`. -/
def AreaLaw (S : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℝ) : Prop := 0 < k ∧ ∀ L, 0 < L → S L = k * L ^ 2

constraint_details.relation: v_min ratio = sqrt(L2/L1), checked as ratio^2 = L2/L1
constraint_details.canEliminate: a candidate committing a minimum-speed ratio other than the square root of its length ratio
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **C9b, minimum-speed scaling.** Under R1, R2 and constant `ρ`, `C_L,max`, `v_min` scales as `√L`: a
committed `v_min` ratio `r ≥ 0` at length ratio `ℓ` with `r² ≠ ℓ` is ruled out. -/
theorem vmin_scaling_rules_out {W S : ℝ → ℝ} {k₁ k₂ ρ Cmax : ℝ} (hW : CubeLaw W k₁) (hS : AreaLaw S k₂)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hCmax : 0 < Cmax) {L₁ L₂ r ℓ : ℝ} (h₁ : 0 < L₁) (h₂ : 0 < L₂)
    (hr : vmin ρ Cmax (W L₂) (S L₂) / vmin ρ Cmax (W L₁) (S L₁) = r) (hℓ : L₂ / L₁ = ℓ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r)
    (hne : r ^ 2 ≠ ℓ) : False := by
  have := vmin_ratio hW hS hρ hCmax h₁ h₂
  rw [hr, hℓ] at this
  have hℓ0 : 0 ≤ ℓ := by rw [← hℓ]; positivity
  exact hne (by rw [this, Real.sq_sqrt hℓ0])

constraint_details.relation: d log v_min / d log L = 1/2
constraint_details.canEliminate: a candidate asserting isometry and constant aerodynamics with a minimum-speed exponent other than 1/2
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **C9c, minimum-speed exponent.** Under R1, R2 and constant `ρ`, `C_L,max`, the exponent of `v_min` on `L` is `1/2`. -/
theorem vmin_exponent_rules_out {W S : ℝ → ℝ} {k₁ k₂ ρ Cmax : ℝ} (hW : CubeLaw W k₁) (hS : AreaLaw S k₂)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hCmax : 0 < Cmax) {L₁ L₂ b : ℝ} (h₁ : 0 < L₁) (h₂ : 0 < L₂) (hne : L₁ ≠ L₂)
    (hb : Real.log (vmin ρ Cmax (W L₂) (S L₂) / vmin ρ Cmax (W L₁) (S L₁)) = b * Real.log (L₂ / L₁))
    (h : b ≠ 1 / 2) : False := by
  have := vmin_log hW hS hρ hCmax h₁ h₂
  rw [hb] at this
  exact h (mul_right_cancel₀ (log_ratio_ne_zero h₁ h₂ hne) this)

constraint_details.relation: speed ratio = sqrt(L2/L1), checked as ratio^2 = L2/L1
constraint_details.canEliminate: a candidate committing to equal Froude number and a speed ratio other than the square root of its length ratio
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **C11, Froude.** At equal Froude number speed scales as `√L`: a committed speed ratio `r ≥ 0` at length
ratio `ℓ` with `r² ≠ ℓ` is ruled out. -/
theorem froude_rules_out {Fr g : ℝ} (hFr : 0 < Fr) (hg : 0 < g) {L₁ L₂ r ℓ : ℝ} (h₁ : 0 < L₁) (h₂ : 0 < L₂)
    (hr : froudeSpeed Fr g L₂ / froudeSpeed Fr g L₁ = r) (hℓ : L₂ / L₁ = ℓ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hne : r ^ 2 ≠ ℓ) :
    False := by
  have := froude_ratio hFr hg h₁ h₂
  rw [hr, hℓ] at this
  have hℓ0 : 0 ≤ ℓ := by rw [← hℓ]; positivity
  exact hne (by rw [this, Real.sq_sqrt hℓ0])
